title: The Verge’s Jennifer Pattison begins answering HomeView test questions
digest: The Verge’s Jennifer Pattison Tuohy has started answering subscriber questions about Apple’s HomeView following her in-depth testing of the device in various rooms. Her test included both desktop and wall-mounted versions for kitchens, bedrooms, offices, and entryways, alongside evaluating new AI-powered Siri features. Family members participated in testing but provided mixed feedback. The Q&A session is open to Verge subscribers at 2 PM local time on November 12, 2026.
